title: Moment of calm
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: darkening storm at dusk, cold slate-blue light, rain, lightning on the horizon.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; a small battered red-and-white fishing boat with a lit wheelhouse, tossing on the waves.
Camera: slow push-in on the three regrouping, the boat visible far behind them; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The three regroup at the railing, catching their breath in the rain; behind them the fishing boat drifts closer to the jagged reef. Penny points urgently at the dark lantern above.
No dialogue.
Sound: heavy breathing, rain, distant waves on the reef.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, Tomkin, the masked hero, the fishing boat), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: They hurry toward the lantern room door.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: heavy breathing, rain, distant waves on the reef.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
